title: CreditApplicationCapabilities
description: Actual credit_application_submit behavior of one deployment. Publish in the A2A AAP extension params.skills["credit_application_submit"].capabilities and the MCP credit tool metadata; the same values apply to every binding. Agents read it before collecting applicant data.

inquiry_types.description: Credit inquiries the dealer can run. An application whose authorized_inquiry is not listed returns INVALID_CONSENT.

joint_applications.description: true when application_type joint is accepted. false: a joint application returns SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED naming /application_type, before any record or credit inquiry.

national_id.description: required: an application without applicant.national_id returns MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD. optional: accepted when present. not_accepted: the dealer collects the identifier itself; a request containing one returns SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED and the value is discarded.

currencies.description: Currencies this skill accepts and returns. Omitted means only USD. Another currency returns SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED naming /currency.
